title: Bakery and Vow
author: Orsen Brightwater
blurb: Silas Coldharbour, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
